effect: The completed pathway explains how higher ADH increases water recovery and how the response can fall as blood concentration returns toward normal.
reaction: The feedback connection was satisfying, though the result largely matched my expectation.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the loop and vessels was most worthwhile: the different limb properties and vessels limiting gradient washout explained how a maintained gradient supports water recovery.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the ADH pathway to the kidney was the least engaging action because it was the only combination available and its result was largely predictable after the preceding explanations.

surprise.text: I was struck by the nearby vessels carrying recovered water away while limiting washout of the gradient; that made the gradient feel like a maintained process rather than a static salt deposit.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the final two combinations were prescribed by the menu, so I was following the available route rather than figuring out compatibility.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see how these mechanisms respond to a drink. The explanations were useful, especially the gradient, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
